description: Committed readings and a structural identity control for the R49 within-run paired facade. Sources: AUDIT 34.35-34.37, TECH-DESIGN 17.98 / 17.101, prereg/R48-u3-coverage-floor.md and the offline verifier in /workspace/r48-readback.py. R48's -6.00pp was a CROSS-RUN difference: two dispatches, 8 vs 12 distilled items, and a memory-free reference that drifted from 0.30 to 0.44. It is not a measurement of the floor. The per-task rows of R48 are not committed here; the identity control is explicitly structural, NOT an experimental result. It exists so the invariant can be exercised on a valid within-run pair without inventing one.

identityControl.description: Structural identity control, NOT a measurement. Both facades carry one scope, one task set and identical outcomes, so a valid pair must report a zero delta.
